lessons.title: Recognizing Big Feelings
lessons.objective: Help students identify and name their emotional state before taking action.

workflow.step_1_warm_up: Check in on the student's readiness to learn.
workflow.step_2_concept: Introduce emotional awareness using simple, concrete language.
workflow.step_3_practice: Present a scenario and ask the student to identify the emotion.
workflow.step_4_reflection: Summarize key takeaways and celebrate progress.

scripts.frustrated: I can see this feels really big right now. You're not in trouble, and it's okay to get stuck. Let's take a slow breath and break this down together.
scripts.mistake: Your thinking makes sense, but let's try that again. Everyone gets another chance to practice.
scripts.overwhelmed: Your feelings are completely okay. Let's slow down and focus on just this one simple step.
scripts.success: You stayed with that even when it was tough! Notice how taking it step-by-step helped you find the answer.

lessons.title: Co-Regulation Techniques
lessons.objective: Guide students through pausing, breathing, and refocusing during moments of stress.

workflow.step_2_concept: Explain how taking a slow breath helps calm the nervous system.
workflow.step_3_practice: Practice a simple breathing exercise together.
workflow.step_4_reflection: Acknowledge the effort and invite reflection on how their body feels.

scripts.frustrated: Let's pause together. Notice your breathing and take a slow breath before we try again.
scripts.mistake: Mistakes are just part of practicing. Let's take a beat and look at it together.
scripts.overwhelmed: We can pause right here. There is no rush.
scripts.success: Great work pausing and staying calm! That helped you work through the problem.

lessons.title: Pause, Name, Connect, Guide
lessons.objective: Teach the four-step active listening response framework.

workflow.step_2_concept: Break down the steps: Pause, Name, Connect, and Guide.
workflow.step_3_practice: Role-play applying the 4-step framework to a everyday conflict.
workflow.step_4_reflection: Review how connecting before correcting makes problem-solving easier.

scripts.frustrated: This is really hard right now, and that is okay. Let's slow down together.
scripts.mistake: That was a good attempt! Let's adjust one detail and try again.
scripts.overwhelmed: Let's break this into one doable step at a time.
scripts.success: You connected the pieces step-by-step—excellent job!
